title: Custom Data Commons agent configuration
description: Schema for this instance's agent-config.json (lives at the per-instance config bucket root). Mirrors the field surface of upstream config.json.example. Same schema is consumed in dev mode (UI panel) and prod mode (bucket file). One instance, one file — no overlay model across instances.

api_base.description: Override for regional / vNext Gemini endpoints.

mcp_model.description: Model used for the MCP tool-loop / planner.

kb_model.description: Model used for the File Search / KB phase.

filestores.description: Gemini File Search corpus IDs (one or more; sharded RAG when multiple).

gemini.description: Gemini model and corpus settings. API keys are deliberately NOT part of this file: the agent resolves them from Secret Manager via the GEMINI_API_KEYS_SECRET and GEMINI_DEMO_API_KEYS_SECRET environment variables. `gemini` is additionalProperties:false, so adding an api_keys/api_key field here is a validation error — that is intentional, and keeps this file safe to commit and to serve from a config bucket.

enabled.description: Set false to run synthesis-only (no tool loop). Used for chat-only fallback when MCP is down.

mcp.description: Data Commons MCP server settings. The endpoint itself is NOT configurable here: the agent builds it from the MCP_PORT environment variable as http://localhost:${MCP_PORT}/mcp (src/mcp/client.py). Set MCP_PORT on the container.

enabled.description: Toggle the File Search RAG phase. False disables the KB pipeline entirely for instances without a corpus.

store_id.description: DEPRECATED single-corpus shim. Use gemini.filestores[] instead. Schema accepts it for backward shape compat; agent ignores it.

mcp_level.description: Reasoning budget for the tool-loop / planner. Primary cost/latency dial.

synthesis_level.description: Reasoning budget for the final synthesizer. Primary cost/latency dial.

prompts.description: Inline overrides for the system prompts. Bodies are normally authored as config/prompts/<slot>.md and fetched from this instance's config bucket at startup; a non-empty string here wins over the file for that slot. The only placeholder the agent substitutes is {{CURRENT_DATETIME}} — everything else in a prompt is literal text, so edit the .md files in your bucket to suit your instance.

query_param_key.description: Soft-gate token for demo links. Appended as ?key=<this> to gate the dev-mode UI panel and the diagnostic endpoints.

proxy_url.description: Legacy: where the agent itself binds. Container env (PROXY_PORT) is the source of truth in the target deployment; schema accepts this key for backward compatibility with upstream config.json.example.
